name: Gorilla Glue Auto
flowering: 56–63 days from seed (breeder); growers often report ~70
climate: Indoors or a warm outdoor summer
story: An autoflowering take on the famous sticky Gorilla Glue cut, bred by Fast Buds by crossing it with their own auto line. It keeps the resin-heavy, pungent character of the original in a compact plant. One of the most-grown autos in public grow diaries.
growNotes: Buds get very sticky; plan good airflow late in bloom.
Breeder time is 56–63 days from seed, many diaries finish nearer 70 days.

parents.note: Sources disagree: Biscotti × The Menthol, or a 707 Seed Bank line (Thin Mints GSC × Kush Cleaner).

story: Anesia took Blue Lobster, the East Coast cult hit that Maine Trees picked out of Compound Genetics' Apples & Bananas × Eye Candy cross, and paired it with Alien Labs' Planet Red. The twist: Planet Red is also an Apples & Bananas child. So your plant carries Apples & Bananas on both sides of the family. Breeders do that to lock in a trait, here the candied-fruit terpenes and the dense, colourful, resin-heavy buds. The 'purple' is a promise of the Red Pop side and the berry lines of Blue Lobster: cool nights late in bloom tend to bring it out.
